name: Gladias
about: Costume test: the starting Gladias profile redesigned with future Veridian clothing instead of present-day clothes. Same invented face and build.
descriptor: a man of about forty, slim and of medium height, light olive skin, short wavy chestnut-brown hair, a neatly trimmed short beard and hazel eyes, wearing a long moss-green woven coat with an asymmetric wrap front and a high soft collar, a fitted cream undertunic, slim charcoal trousers tucked into soft grey boots, a thin silver band around his throat, a small earpiece and a slim wrist device
